findings.title: bank_tracker manifest declares no `source` on 7 consumer port(s) the design wires
findings.detail: Ports cmd_act_valid, cmd_act_bank, cmd_act_row, cmd_pre_valid, cmd_rd_valid, cmd_wr_valid, cmd_ref_valid are inputs that the integrated design drives from another block, but the manifest does not say from where. Validation carries these edges by hand in integration_overrides.json; the backend's set gate lists them as unresolved slots. Add `"source": "<block>.<port>"` to each.

findings.title: data_path.cmd_aux declares source scheduler.cmd_aux, but the design needs glue
findings.detail: The manifest says data_path.cmd_aux is driven directly by scheduler.cmd_aux. It is not: cmd_gen's feedback carries no aux tag, but data_path needs the issued command's aux to tag read responses (rd_rsp_aux). Registered one cycle to align with the registered fb_rd_valid/fb_wr_valid pulses. Same missing-feedback-signal gap as the bank workaround — covered by the filed fb-bank finding; the design wants fb_aux. Driver used: scheduler.cmd_aux. Either the RTL should consume scheduler.cmd_aux as declared, or the manifest should stop claiming a direct connection.

findings.title: data_path.wr_data_valid declares source wb_port.req_valid, but the design needs expr_glue
findings.detail: The manifest says data_path.wr_data_valid is driven directly by wb_port.req_valid. It is not: data_path buffers a write word when wb_port's write request is ACCEPTED (valid && we && ready). No single design port carries that event; it is the same accept condition cmd_queue enqueues on. Driver used: wb_port.req_valid && wb_port.req_we && cmd_queue.enq_ready. Either the RTL should consume wb_port.req_valid as declared, or the manifest should stop claiming a direct connection.
